    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">【ASP.NET Core】Cookie 验证中回调用 URL 自动跳转的问题</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>一个多月没更新了。7月末的时候有个 Web 看板的玩意儿，也不知道他们找了什么人设计了个界面（估计是个妹子，UI 花里花哨的），然后他们说要做成这样。我说你们就这么一点点破数据，才14个字段的实时记录，用得着这么复杂的界面去显示吗。做出来也没屌用，没啥数据可呈现的。开了几次会跟他们吵了几场。最后老周奋战 12 天给他们全搞定，包括后台的设备管理、用户、角色、权限分配管理、上传日志维护。前端页面的左边就做成像火车站的大屏幕那样，把最新的数据自动滚动显示；右边就像游戏里面的“血条”，用一排进度条动态显示每个车间，车间中每排机器的操作员检测零件的数量。工作效率高的人显示为金色，然后依次红、蓝、粉，工作效率最差的显示为灰色。他们说这叫“员工学习曲线”，反正都不知道哪个大头鬼发明的名词。新员工第一个月要完成 70% 的任务，第二个月要完成 80% 的任务。如果前三个月完成的百分比不达标，卷铺盖走人！虽然他们的管理严格，不过待遇不错的，双休，不加班，每周四还组织搞活动，周五发零食。这年头，人家打工仔都比程序员快活。</p>
<p>===================================================================</p>
<p>宇宙人都知道，HTTP 通信是无状态的，所以总得有个东西来存放状态。尤其在登录方面，要有个东西来保存登录信息，才不至于每打开一个页面都要登录一次。传统规矩，服务器用 Session，浏览器用 Cookie。绝大多数情况下是可用的，但部分非正常人类，浏览器禁用了 Cookie。这个老周遇过，JS 动态发出请求，然后携带登录信息（当然不含用户名和密码的）。类似 Token，那是很多年前的活了，那年代还不流行什么 Token 的，其实是在服务器上动态生成的一串字符，在数据库用有个表将这串字符与用户对应起来，并存储过期时间。如果过期了或者对不上，就验证失败。Token 也没啥高级的，别人拿到你的 Token 照样能冒充你。</p>
<p>在 ASP.NET Core 中，Cookie 验证可以配置登录路径、注销路径，以及回调URL的字段名。相信有搞过 ASP.NET Core 的伙伴都知道，老周不多介绍了。</p>
<p>但是，如果各位细心的话，会发现执行登录后不会自动跳转的。下面老周用一个不健全但结构的例子演示一下。</p>
<p>咱们明确：</p>
<p>1、老周这里用 SQLite 数据库演示；</p>
<p>2、需要用 EF Core；</p>
<p>3、Cookie 验证会配置登录、注销等路径；</p>
<p>4、使用 MVC。</p>
<p>好，动手！老传统，咱们从抽象到具体。数据库是最抽象的，就从实体模型开始。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> UserInfo
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> Uid { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> UName { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span>; } = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">admin</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> Passwd { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span>; } = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>这个够了，有ID，有用户名和密码字段。现在咱们做好 DbContext 类的派生。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> MyAppContext : DbContext
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"> HashHelper hasher</span></strong>;

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> MyAppContext(DbContextOptions&lt;MyAppContext&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> options, HashHelper hh)
        : </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">base</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(options)
    {
        hasher </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> hh;
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 数据集合</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> DbSet&lt;UserInfo&gt; Users { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">protected</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
    {
        modelBuilder.Entity</span>&lt;UserInfo&gt;(ent =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 主键</span>
            ent.HasKey(u =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> u.Uid);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 表名</span>
            ent.ToTable(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tb_Users</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 初始数据</span>
            ent.HasData(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> UserInfo
            {
                Uid </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                UName </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">admin</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                Passwd </span>= hasher.MakeHash(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">admin</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            });
        });
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>眼尖的老伙伴发现了一个叫 HashHelper 的东西从构造函数注入了，它是啥服务？那是老周自主研发的加密器，用 sha256 哈希。老周做项目都习惯用 SHA256 以上的处理密码的，老早就不用 MD5 了。实际项目中，咱们一般不把原密码存入数据库，都是哈希一下再存。安全在 99.99% 的情况是足够的。其实很多项目就算直接存明文都没关系，你以为这个破东西有多出名啊，黑客们根本不感兴趣。许多小工厂的项目，老周甚至都不加密的。</p>
<p>下面是 HashHelper 的代码，很简单，就不写注释了。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> HashHelper
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> MakeHash(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> input)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Convert.ToHexStringLower(SHA256.HashData(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(input)));
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>在服务容器注册一下自己的 DbContext。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>builder.Services.AddDbContext&lt;MyAppContext&gt;(opt =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
{
   opt.UseSqlite(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">data source=test.db</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
});</span></pre>
</div>
<p>为了证明老周前面提到的问题，咱们搞个 MVC 控制器。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>[Route(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">[controller]/[action]</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)]
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> MainController : Controller
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 这是主页，要授权后才能访问</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    [Authorize]
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> IActionResult Default()
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> View(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">~/Views/Default.cshtml</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> GET 方式，主要返回UI，让你输入用户名和密码</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> IActionResult Login(<strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>?</span></strong><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"> url</span></strong>)
    {
        <strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">ViewData[</span></strong></span><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">url</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>] =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> url;
</span></span></strong>        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> View(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">~/Views/Login.cshtml</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 这个是 POST 的，接收输入的用户和密码</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    [HttpPost]
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span> Task&lt;IActionResult&gt; Login(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> username, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> passwd, <strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>?</span></strong><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"> url</span></strong>, [FromServices]HashHelper hasher, [FromServices]MyAppContext dbContext)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 全转为小写再比较，咱们这里不区分大小写</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> hashedPwd =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> hasher.MakeHash(passwd);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> lowcasename =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> username.ToLower();
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> user = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> dbContext.Users.FirstOrDefaultAsync(u=&gt;u.UName.ToLower() == lowcasename &amp;&amp; u.Passwd ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> hashedPwd);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> null 就是没查到用户</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span>(user == <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 回去继续登录</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> Redirect(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/main/login?url=</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> url);
        }

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 准备登录用的各种证据</span>
        Claim c = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier, user.UName);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 创建标识</span>
        ClaimsIdentity idt = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">([c], CookieAuthenticationDefaults.AuthenticationScheme);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 创建用户实体，这个会跟随HTTP管道周期内的 HttpContext</span>
        ClaimsPrincipal princ = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(idt);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 执行登录，其实执行这个后会跳转的，但实际上没有跳转</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"> HttpContext.SignInAsync</span></strong>(princ);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 无内容（后面运行之后你就懂的）</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> NoContent();
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>注意那个叫 url 的参数。这个就是传回调地址用的，Cookie 验证默认的字段名是 ReturnUrl，当老周不喜欢这么长的名字，所以会配置为 url，这个后面配置验证时再说。</p>
<p>验证用户名和密码是否正确的工作是由咱们自己完成的，如果正确，允许登录，就交给&nbsp;HttpContext.SignInAsync 方法去处理，它会在服务器上存 Session，并生成发回给浏览器的 Cookie。</p>
<p>下面代码配置 Cookie 验证。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>builder.Services.AddAuthentication(CookieAuthenticationDefaults.AuthenticationScheme).AddCookie(opt =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
{
   opt.Cookie.Path </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>;     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Cookie 范围路径</span>
   opt.Cookie.Name = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">guang_tou_qiang</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Cookie的名称</span>
   opt.LoginPath = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/main/login</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>;   <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 登入</span>
   opt.LogoutPath = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/main/logout</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 登出</span>
   opt.ReturnUrlParameter = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">url</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>;  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 回调 URL 字段名</span>
});</pre>
</div>
<p>Cookie.Name 是生成的 Cookie 的名称，默认会带“ASP.NET Core”字样，这样不友好，所以一般要给它分配个别的名字，比如老周叫它“光头强”。</p>
<p>LogOut 其实没有实现的，这不是重点。注销登录也很简单，调用一下 HttpContext.SignOutAsync 方法完事了，它会删除 Cookie 和 Session 中保存的内容。记住回调用 URL 的字段名已改为 url。</p>
<p>比如，你要访问主页 http://hehe.net/，此时，验证和授权中间件分析后发现你小子没登录，然后自动跳转到 LoginPath 配置的路径。并且加上回调URL，http://hehe.net/main/login?url=/，意思就是你登录成功跳转回 url 指定的路径。</p>
<p>再比如，你要访问 http://hehe.net/tools，结果验证不通过，跳转到 http://hehe.net/main/login?url=/tools，等你成功登录后，再跳转回 /tools 页面。</p>
<p>这里各位要注意：大多数时候，咱们要呈现一个界面，让用户输入用户名和密码（其他不用输入的不讨论），然后发回服务器。也就是说，HTTP-GET 方式调用 main/login 时由框架自动传递 url 的值，可是这里你 return View 返回登录UI，这使得一轮HTTP会话结束了；等输入好用户名和密码，POST 回 main/login 时，url 的值已经丢了。所以，这里咱们在 GET 方式调用 main/login 时把 url 存到 ViewData 字典中，return View() 会自动把它传给视图，然后在视图文件里，咱们再从 ViewData 取出 url 的值。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">form </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">action</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="<strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">login?url=@ViewData["</span></strong></span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">url"]</span></strong>" method</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="post"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">table</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tr</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">td</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>用户名：<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">td</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">td</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">input </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">type</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="text"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> name</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="username"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> required</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">td</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tr</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tr</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">td</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>密码：<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">td</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">td</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
                <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">input </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">type</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="password"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> name</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="passwd"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> required</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">td</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tr</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">table</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">button </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">type</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="submit"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>登录<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">button</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">form</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span></pre>
</div>
<p>在 form 中咱们可以让 action 的值为 /main/login?url=&lt;从ViewData取出的值&gt;，这等于将框架传给我们的 url 的值又传回给服务器。这样一来，执行 POST 的 Login 方法时，就不会丢失 url 的值了。</p>
<p>之所以要让 GET 和 POST 的方法都叫 Login，是因为 Cookie 验证在传递回调用 URL 时要检查当前路径是不是 LoginPath，如果是才会进行跳转。所以这里我们要让 GET 和 POST 的路径都是 /main/login?url=....。</p>
<p>咱们运行一下。首次进入主页面失败，这时框架能自动跳转到登录页。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/367389/202608/367389-20260822175632779-947563618.png" alt="image" width="223" height="98" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>数据库默认创建的用户名和密码都是 admin。点击登录后，你会发现没有转到主页。是没有成功吗？不，登录是成功的，但没有自动跳转。通过开发人员工具抓取的小笼包可以看到：服务器返回的是 No Content。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/367389/202608/367389-20260822180017501-1250269505.png" alt="image" width="469" height="94" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>查看一下，有 Cookie 返回的。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/367389/202608/367389-20260822180208398-683999085.png" alt="image" width="553" height="128" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>还记得吗？咱们的 MVC 控制器里，就是 return NoContent() 的。</p>
<p>这么一搞，原因找到了。由于咱们是在 MVC Action 方法成员中调用 SignIn 方法的，虽然框架有自动跳转，但 MVC 在返回时，会把框架设置的标头覆盖了。</p>
<p>说人话就是：要想保证框架自己的跳转功能有效，登录处理就要在 HTTP 管道上完成，即在中间件层完成。</p>
<p>那，怎么解决呢？最最最简单的方法就是无视框架的跳转，在 MVC 控制器代码中咱们自己手动跳转。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    [HttpPost]
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span> Task&lt;IActionResult&gt; Login(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> username, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> passwd, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> url, [FromServices]HashHelper hasher, [FromServices]MyAppContext dbContext)
    {
         ……
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> return NoContent();
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 手动跳转</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">Redirect(url ?? <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/main/default</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span></span></strong><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">)</span></strong>;
    }</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>如果你要求必须保证框架能自动跳转，能做到吗？能，只要把检验用户名/密码和登录的处理逻辑放到 HTTP 管道上就行了，只有让用户输入这一步才走 MVC 控制器里返回视图。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>主页/验证失败 -&gt; /login?url=... -&gt; <strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">登录界面</span></strong> -&gt; /login?url=... -&gt; ...</pre>
</div>
<p>也就是在呈现登录界面这一步绕一个圈，跳 MVC 里面去，最终又跳回 HTTP 管道。</p>
<p>现在，咱们把 Cookie 验证的配置改一下（主要改登入/登出路径）。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>builder.Services.AddAuthentication(CookieAuthenticationDefaults.AuthenticationScheme).AddCookie(opt =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
{
   opt.Cookie.Path </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>;     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Cookie 范围路径</span>
   opt.Cookie.Name = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">guang_tou_qiang</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Cookie的名称</span>
   opt.LoginPath = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><strong><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">/login</span></strong><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>;   <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 登入</span>
   opt.LogoutPath = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><strong><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">/logout</span></strong><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 登出</span>
   opt.ReturnUrlParameter = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">url</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>;  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 回调 URL 字段名</span>
});</pre>
</div>
<p>咱们在 HTTP 管道上直接实现登入/登出。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>app.MapGet(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/login</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, (<strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>? url</span></strong>) =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
{
   </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 这里是由框架自动转过来的</span>
   Console.WriteLine(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">-- 进入登录入口</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
   </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 我们啥也不处理，目的只是呈现登录界面
   </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 记得把 url 传过去，这个不能丢了，不然等会玩不下去了</span>
   <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> Results.Redirect(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/main/login?url=</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> url);
});

app.MapPost(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/login</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (
   [FromForm] </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> username,
   [FromForm] </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> passwd,
   [FromQuery] </span><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>? url</span></strong>) =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
{
   HashHelper hasher </span>= app.Services.GetRequiredService&lt;HashHelper&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();

   </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> hashedPwd =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> hasher.MakeHash(passwd);
   </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> lowcasename =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> username.ToLower();

   UserInfo</span>?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> user;
   </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> scop =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"> app.Services.CreateScope()</span></strong>)
   {
      MyAppContext context </span>= scop.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService&lt;MyAppContext&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
      user </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> context.Users.FirstOrDefaultAsync(u =&gt; u.UName.ToLower() == lowcasename &amp;&amp; u.Passwd ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> hashedPwd);
   }
   </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> null 就是没查到用户</span>
   <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (user == <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
   {
      </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 回去继续登录</span>
      <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> Results.Redirect(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/login?url=</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> url);
   }

   </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 准备登录</span>
   Claim c = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier, user.UName);
   ClaimsIdentity idt </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">([c], CookieAuthenticationDefaults.AuthenticationScheme);
   ClaimsPrincipal princ </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(idt);
   </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 执行登录</span>
   <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Results.SignIn(princ);
});

app.MapGet(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/logout</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span> context =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
{
   </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 注销很简单</span>
   <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> context.SignOutAsync();
});</span></pre>
</div>
<p>/login 是有两个的，一个GET，一个POST。GET 是由框架跳转的，这时我们绕到登录界面 /main/login，并把 url 参数传过去。之后就会显示登录界面，输入用户名和密码后，登录，又 POST 回 /login，并把 url 又传回服务器。</p>
<p>所以，真正校验密码和完成登录的是在 POST 版的 /login。由于 Minim-API 创建的中间件是单实例服务，不能直接获取 DbContext。它是范围（作用域）服务。要通过 Services.CreateScope 方法创建一个范围级别的服务容器才能获取。当然，你在&nbsp;AddDbContext 时确实可以通过选项将 DbContext 配置为单实例服务，但严重不推荐这样做，DbContext 最好用完就释放。</p>
<p>之后的登录逻辑一样，要准备 Principal。不过，这次不需要调用 HttpContext.SignInAsync 方法，而是直接用 TypedResults （或Results） 对象的静态方法——&nbsp;SignIn。</p>
<p>注销时调用 HhttpContext.SignOutAsync，或者 Results / TypedResults 的 SignOut 方法。</p>
<p>在登录界面的视图文件中，要把 form 的 action 改一下，记得用查询字符串传回 url。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">form </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">action</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="<strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">/login?url=@ViewData["</span></strong></span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">url"]</span></strong>" method</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="post"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    ……
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">form</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span></pre>
</div>
<p>一切看着很顺利，但一运行就……</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/367389/202608/367389-20260822190053748-1284422355.png" alt="image" width="606" height="117" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>这是没有配置好 anti-forgery 导致的，很好解决。三步走：</p>
<p>1、在配置服务容器阶段，调用&nbsp; AddAntiforgery 方法。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>builder.Services.AddAntiforgery();</pre>
</div>
<p>2、在 HTTP 管道中，在验证和授权后面调用 UseAntiforgery 方法。为什么要在授权之后呢，因为不想在那时候就生成 anti-token。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">app.UseRouting();
app.UseAuthentication();
app.UseAuthorization();

<strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">app.UseAntiforgery();</span></strong></span></pre>
</div>
<p>3、在视图中，form 里面要加这一行。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">form </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">action</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="/login?url=@ViewData["</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">url"]" method</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="post"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">@Html.AntiForgeryToken()</span></strong>
    ……
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">form</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span></pre>
</div>
<p>就是生成 token 用的，最终 HTML 会变成这样。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/367389/202608/367389-20260822190811034-1747365550.png" alt="image" width="443" height="75" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>同时还带个 Cookie。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/367389/202608/367389-20260822190852010-1586767529.png" alt="image" width="325" height="108" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>在登录页面输入用户名和密码，就行了。</p>
<p>这样你会发现，现在框架能自动跳转了。</p>
<p>其实，呈现登录页面这一步不是说一定要绕进 MVC 里，而是因为老周前面演示时用的 MVC，其实你用啥方法就行的。比如用字符串直接拼个 HTML 文档返回也可以的。或者在 wwwroot 目录中放到静态 HTML 页也可以。总之方法多多，任君选择。只要达到让用户输入信息的目的就行。</p>
<p>最后，咱们去瞧一下源代码，看看框架怎么跳转的。Cookie 验证的处理类是&nbsp;CookieAuthenticationHandler。当登录操作触发时，由 IAuthenticationService 服务调用&nbsp;HandleSignInAsync 方法。在处理完登录事宜后会有这么一段。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> shouldHonorReturnUrlParameter = Options.LoginPath.HasValue &amp;&amp; OriginalPath ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Options.LoginPath;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> ApplyHeaders(shouldRedirect: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span>, shouldHonorReturnUrlParameter, signedInContext.Properties);</pre>
</div>
<p>ApplyHeaders 通过设置标头的方式完成跳转。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span> Task ApplyHeaders(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">bool</span> shouldRedirect, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">bool</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> shouldHonorReturnUrlParameter, AuthenticationProperties properties)
{
    Response.Headers.CacheControl </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> HeaderValueNoCacheNoStore;
    Response.Headers.Pragma </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> HeaderValueNoCache;
    Response.Headers.Expires </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> HeaderValueEpocDate;

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (shouldRedirect &amp;&amp; Response.StatusCode == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">200</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> set redirect uri in order:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 1. properties.RedirectUri
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 2. query parameter ReturnUrlParameter (if the request path matches the path set in the options)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Absolute uri is not allowed if it is from query string as query string is not
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> a trusted source.</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> redirectUri =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> properties.RedirectUri;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (shouldHonorReturnUrlParameter &amp;&amp; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.IsNullOrEmpty(redirectUri))
        {
            <strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">redirectUri </span></strong></span><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">=</span></strong><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"> Request.Query[Options.ReturnUrlParameter]</span></strong>;
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>.IsNullOrEmpty(redirectUri) || !<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">IsHostRelative(redirectUri))
            {
                redirectUri </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
            }
        }

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (redirectUri != <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"> Events.RedirectToReturnUrl</span></strong>(
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> RedirectContext&lt;CookieAuthenticationOptions&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(Context, Scheme, Options, properties, redirectUri));
        }
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>通过&nbsp;Request.Query 获取了回调 URL，从这里看到，跳转的条件有二：</p>
<p>1、有设置的 ReturnUrl 字段；</p>
<p>2、当前请求的路径要和 LoginPath 配置的相同。这就是我们上面为什么 GET 和 POST 都要 /login 的原因，这是为了保证路径不变。</p>
<p>再到&nbsp;CookieAuthenticationEvents 类中，看看真正的跳转代码。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> Func&lt;RedirectContext&lt;CookieAuthenticationOptions&gt;, Task&gt; OnRedirectToReturnUrl { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span>; } = context =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
 {
     </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (IsAjaxRequest(context.Request))
     {
         context.<strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">Response.Headers.Location </span></strong></span><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">=</span></strong><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"> context.RedirectUri</span></strong>;
     }
     </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
     {
         context.<strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">Response.Redirect(context.RedirectUri)</span></strong>;
     }
     </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Task.CompletedTask;
 };</span></pre>
</div>
<p>这下看懂了吧。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>好了，今天老周就水到这里了。要开饭了。</p>
